recipes.name: Chicken & Mozzarella Hoagie
instructions: Heat a skillet over low heat with a drizzle of oil. Add the vegetables with a pinch of salt and sweat them slowly for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they're soft, sweet, and lightly caramelized. Set aside when done.

Meanwhile, thinly slice the chicken breast. Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat and add the oil. Add the chicken, season with salt, dried minced garlic, and Aleppo pepper, then chop it into small pieces with a spatula as it sears until browned and cooked through.

Pile the cooked peppers and onions over the chicken. Cover everything with the shredded mozzarella. Place the hoagie roll, cut-side down, over the cheese for a minute or two, allowing the bread to steam while the cheese melts.

Spread a little mayonnaise inside the steamed hoagie roll. Add the shredded lettuce and sliced tomato. Carefully transfer the cheesy chicken mixture into the roll, and finish with a sprinkle of dried oregano. Wrap the sandwich tightly in sandwich paper or foil. Let it rest for 1–2 minutes before slicing in half and serving.
